original_requirement: Add independently verifiable build/config fingerprints and post-commit origin/executor bindings without changing runtime or business decisions.
operational_definition: Every approved R0F creation/resume path produces deterministic, private, independently re-hashable evidence or an explicit unknown/legacy status while all business projections remain unchanged.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not treat a child hash without stored child content as independently verifiable.
Do not backfill legacy origin from a current executor.
Do not let Git verification authorize packaged deployment or vice versa.
Do not call credentials, providers, network, or models during collection.
closed_world_justification: The approved change is limited to named run-creation/activation methods, versioned definition schemas, a dedicated sidecar store, and a pure preflight boundary.

constraint_traceability.implementation: DefinitionStore persists child and parent definitions content-addressed and verify_runtime_binding_sidecars re-hashes the complete graph.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Exact graph verification passes and child tamper returns invalid.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Legacy resume never receives a fabricated origin.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Database only marks creation branches origin; existing activation is executor and canonical reader retains unverifiable_legacy.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Legacy resume has origin_count zero and a null origin fingerprint.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Instrumentation cannot change ordinary business behavior.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Callbacks run after transaction and swallow observation failure; parity filters only declared diagnostic event types.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Before/after run projection is identical and a raising observer leaves the run committed.

projected_failure_mechanisms: packaged files differ from embedded manifest
sidecar write or event append fails
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: R0F does not modify Prompt, model dispatch, parser, adapter, validator, retry, fallback, or model-output contracts; protected source hashes are baseline-bound.
why_previous_tests_missed: Earlier reliability phases recorded workflow evidence but did not bind runs to an independently stored build/config definition graph.

sibling_boundaries.evidence: Both creation methods notify origin only after commit; direct running creation also records executor.
New activation records origin; resume/retry/recovery activation records executor only.
Mode-specific preflight tests prevent cross-mode authorization.

remaining_risks: Cold build capture exceeds the planned 250 ms target.
No real canary or approved build/config pair exists in R0F.
Double diagnostic failure remains a coverage gap by fail-open design.
